[[25,802 BBY]] {{Flash}} |series=''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' tie-in |preceded by="[[Eruption]]"{{InsiderCite|141|Eruption}} |followed by="[[The Adventures of Lanoree Brock, Je'daii Ranger]]""[[The Adventures of Lanoree Brock, Je'daii Ranger]]" }} '''''Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void''''' is a novel written by author [[Tim Lebbon]]. It is a tie-in to the [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi|comic series of the same name]], set around the same time as the comic's [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm|first story arc]].{{Twitter|timlebbon|status/325244030705340417|[[Tim Lebbon]]|quote=@DigiFluid Sure, it's pretty much at the same time as the Force Storm arc.|archivedate=20200813210755}} The novel was released on [[May 7]], [[2013]] and included the short story ''[[Eruption]]'' by [[John Ostrander]] and an excerpt of [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|the first part]] of [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'']] by John Ostrander and [[Jan Duursema]]. The [[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void (audiobook)|audio version]] is narrated by [[January LaVoy]]. The paperback edition was released on [[April 1]], [[2014]]. At the time of its publication, it was among the last of the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] (now known as [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]) novels to be released.
